rootCause: GIA LGDR dossier PDF 2496027047: pdfjs CanvasGraphics.paintChar fails because root @napi-rs/canvas rejects the font object pdfjs passes (no canvasFactory). OCR never starts — parser is irrelevant.

architecture.label: Add primary renderer upgrade (factory backend replaces production implementation)
architecture.rationale: pdfjs-napi-factory succeeds on 100% of anchor PDFs including GIA LGDR dossier 2496027047. Production path fails on dossier due to paintChar/font binding. Factory is same pdfjs stack with canvasFactory + polyfills — not a second runtime.
architecture.minimumChangePath: Extract Sarine render helper from gcal-sarine-image-ocr.ts into shared pdf-render.ts; point renderPdfPagePngAtScale() at factory backend. No external deps. Keep pdfjs for text layer.
architecture.expectedExtractionRecovery: 2496027047: 0% → estimated 70–85% after render fix (OCR already yields ~1700 chars with diagram tokens). 6233708773/2527039693: no regression. IGI/GCAL: no regression expected.
